rows.summary: JM Financial Limited has informed the Exchange that  JM Financial (Middle East) Limited  has been incorporated today i.e., October 12, 2026, in Abu Dhabi Global Market, as a wholly owned subsidiary of JM Financial Overseas Holdings Private Limited and a wholly owned step-down subsidiary of the Company.
